question: Where can I get a list of hydropower plants and dams in Spain, with location, capacity (MW), reservoir volume, operator and annual generation?

answer.summary: No single un-gated official dataset covers all Spanish hydropower plants with MW, operator, reservoir volume, and annual generation. For dams, MITECO's UP_Presas_y_embalses ArcGIS REST service covers 3,208 dams and 3,170 reservoirs with coordinates, volume (hm3), and operator. For hydro plants, MITECO's WFS (876 plants) lacks MW in 88% of rows and omits operators; PRETOR/REPROv2 use CAPTCHAs; Electra's bulk dump omits technology. Non-official datasets are also partial (JRC 342 plants and WRI 124 plants lack small-hydro operators and current annual MWh); pair them with basin/regional sources (CH Duero, CH Jucar, CH Cantabrico, INEGA, DERA).
main_caveats: MITECO UP_Presas_y_embalses USO mislabels major hydro dams (ALDEADAVILA, ALCANTARA, ALMENDRA, CORTES II) as Abastecimiento; never filter USO to find hydro dams.
In UP_Presas_y_embalses Layer 0, multi-dike dams repeat rows (ALMENDRA x4) each repeating full NMN_CAPAC; sum volume from Layer 1 (Embalses) and filter FASE='Explotación'.
MITECO WFS agua:aprov_hidro_central (876 plants) has potencia_t=0 in 770/876 rows, lat=0 in 34/876, and no operator; Electra dump lacks tech, >50 MW phases, and froze 2026-01-27.
Observed annual generation per plant is not published nationwide; MITECO, REE REData, and CNMC publish only aggregates, leaving CH Duero, CH Jucar, and ENTSO-E (>=100 MW).
MITECO static dam Shapefiles use an Altcha anti-bot gate and RAIPRE queries (PRETOR/REPROv2) use image CAPTCHAs; use MITECO ArcGIS REST UP_Presas_y_embalses instead.
answer.confidence_reason: Directly queried MITECO ArcGIS REST, GeoServer WFS, Electra, REData, CNMC, 9 basins, 5 regional portals, JRC, WRI, ENTSO-E, GeoDAR, GEM, SEPREM, ohsome, and BOE.

attributes.note: All 3,208 MITECO ArcGIS dams and 342/342 JRC plants have coords; 34/876 MITECO WFS plants have lat=0; Electra, CH Duero, and INEGA lack coords.
attributes.gap_note: Electra, CH Duero, and INEGA Galicia plant registries omit coordinates, and 34/876 MITECO WFS plant points have corrupted latitude=0 coordinates.

attributes.note: MITECO WFS gives kW in only 106/876 rows; Electra omits >50 MW Fases; JRC gives 342/342 plants (16,084.5 MW); basins/regions cover local plants.
attributes.gap_note: No single un-gated official open dataset provides MW capacity for both >50 MW (REPROv2 CAPTCHA) and <=50 MW (PRETOR CAPTCHA) hydro plants nationwide.

attributes.note: MITECO UP_Presas_y_embalses gives NMN_CAPAC (hm3) for 2,672/3,170 reservoirs and Embalses_Mapa covers 375 >5 hm3 weekly; JRC links volume to 62/342 plants.
attributes.gap_note: 498/3,170 minor reservoirs in MITECO Layer 1 lack NMN_CAPAC, and no official national dataset provides a join key linking reservoir volume to hydro plants.

attributes.note: MITECO ArcGIS gives TITULAR for 3,185/3,208 dams; MITECO WFS/Electra omit plant operator (PRETOR/REPROv2 CAPTCHA); WRI covers 124 plants; INEGA covers Galicia.
attributes.gap_note: MITECO omits Titular from Electra bulk dumps and WFS; CH Cantabrico redacts natural-person owners under LO 3/2018; PRETOR/REPROv2 public queries use CAPTCHA.

attributes.note: Not published per plant nationwide (REE/MITECO/CNMC give totals); CH Duero (169/435) and CH Jucar (33/60) publish basin MWh; ENTSO-E covers >=100 MW units.
attributes.gap_note: MITECO, REE (REData), and CNMC publish generation only aggregated nationally, regionally, or by technology; only CH Duero, CH Jucar, and ENTSO-E (>=100 MW) publish unit/plant MWh.

sources.adds: Primary national inventory of 3,208 dams/ponds (Layer 0) and 3,170 reservoirs (Layer 1) with exact coordinates, reservoir capacity (NMN_CAPAC in hm3), operator (TITULAR), dam height, river, basin, and phase, accessible openly without the Altcha gate on MITECO's static Shapefile page.
sources.summary: MITECO DGA — Inventario de Presas y Embalses (UP_Presas_y_embalses ArcGIS REST)
sources.coverage_note: Spain (national, all inter-community and intra-community basins including islands)
sources.data_date: 2021-12-31 (source inventory snapshot dated 2021-12-30/31; hosted FeatureServer last edited 2023-04-25)
caveats: Consult the main caveats and the complete reading traps and access evidence in the detail.

coverage.geographic: Spain (national, all inter-community and intra-community basins including islands)

unit.value: hm3 (million m3) for reservoir volume (NMN_CAPAC) and annual inflow (AP_M_ANUAL); meters (m) for dam height (ALT_CIMIEN), crest length (LONG_CORON), and elevations; hectares (ha) for NMN_SUP (with mixed km2 outliers); km2 for SUP_CUENCA.
unit.quote: NMN_CAPAC: Capacidad del embalse a NMN (hm3) [Layer 0] / Volumen del embalse a NMN (hm3) [Layer 1]; ALT_CIMIEN: Altura desde cimientos (m)

inclusion_rule.value: Dams, reservoirs, and off-stream ponds >5 m height or >100,000 m3 (0.1 hm3) capacity under Spanish dam safety rules (RD 9/2008 / RD 264/2021 / Orden TED/572/2025), regardless of ownership; inventory also retains some smaller structures (<0.1 hm3) and planned/abandoned works.
inclusion_rule.quote: En el Registro se inscribirán todas las presas y embalses y balsas de altura superior a cinco metros o de capacidad mayor de 100.000 metros cúbicos, sean de titularidad pública o privada, existentes, en construcción o que vayan a construir

reference_date.value: 2021-12-31 (source inventory snapshot dated 2021-12-30/31; hosted FeatureServer last edited 2023-04-25)

update_frequency.value: Annual (declared on datos.gob.es, though public snapshot has remained at 2021-12 / April 2023 pending Orden TED/572/2025 registry updates)

exclusions.value: Does not include installed power capacity (MW) or annual electricity generation; minor weirs <=5 m and <=100,000 m3 are generally excluded.
exclusions.quote: Inventario de presas y embalses de España, donde se puede consultar su ubicación geográfica, datos sobre la cuenca, capacidades de embalse, estado de los documentos de seguridad

key_fields.meaning: Dam/reservoir owner or concessionaire operator (populated in 3,185/3,208 dams; 3,040/3,170 reservoirs)
Reservoir capacity at Normal Maximum Level in hm3 (string in Layer 0; double in Layer 1, populated 2,672/3,170)
Dam height from foundation in meters (Layer 0; mixes numeric strings and text unknowns)
Lifecycle status in Layer 0 (Explotación: 1,910; blank: 646; Proyecto: 491; others: 161)
Declared water uses (corrupted/misclassified for major hydro dams)

how_to_use.example_result: {"attributes": {"FID": 1, "ID_INFRAES": 2999, "CODIGO": "12350074", "NOMBRE": "SATAUTEJO", "FASE": "Explotación", "TITULAR": "AYUNTAMIENTO DE LAS PALMAS", "CAUCE": "BARRANCO DEL COLEGIO", "DEMARC": "GRAN CANARIA", "PROVINCIA": "Las Palmas", "TIPO": "Presa de fábrica de mampostería", "USO": "Abastecimiento", "NMN_CAPAC": "0.107", "ALT_CIMIEN": "32"}, "geometry": {"x": -15.49, "y": 28.05}}
steps: Paginate Layer 0 (dams, 3,208 records) and Layer 1 (reservoirs, 3,170 polygons) using resultOffset=0 and resultOffset=2000 (maxRecordCount=2000), setting outSR=4326 and f=json or f=geojson.
Filter Layer 0 FASE == 'Explotación' (note 646 rows have blank FASE including active dams like MEQUINENZA; 491 are Proyecto).
Join or compute total reservoir capacity from Layer 1 (Embalses) rather than summing Layer 0 NMN_CAPAC.
reading_traps: USO severely mislabels hydroelectric dams: ALDEADAVILA, ALCANTARA, ALMENDRA, and CORTES II are all coded USO='Abastecimiento' instead of 'Hidroeléctrico' (2,075 rows are Abastecimiento; only ~77 contain Hidroeléctrico).

Layer 0 lists each auxiliary dam/dike separately while repeating the full reservoir volume on every row (e.g. ALMENDRA has 4 rows each carrying NMN_CAPAC='2586.5'); summing Layer 0 NMN_CAPAC overcounts volumes.

Layer 0 stores numeric metrics like NMN_CAPAC and ALT_CIMIEN as strings (including text like 'Desconocida la altura sobre cimientos'); Layer 1 NMN_SUP mixes hectares with km2 (Mequinenza=0.754) and outliers (2.268e12).

Static ZIP downloads at MITECO's download page (DescargaFichero?f=egis_presa_geoetrs89.zip) are blocked by an Altcha proof-of-work gate, legacy wms.mapama.gob.es fails TLS cert validation, and INFORME links inside rows point to dead sig.mapama.gob.es URLs.

problems: Static ZIP links on landing_url are gated by an Altcha proof-of-work challenge; ArcGIS REST UP_Presas_y_embalses serves the same inventory openly.

caveats: Consult the main caveats and the complete reading traps and access evidence in the detail.

unit.value: kW for potencia_t (max 915,200 = 915.2 MW); meters (m) for gross head sbruto_m.

exclusions.value: No operator/owner field, no reservoir volume, no annual generation; capacity potencia_t is 0 in 770 of 876 records.

key_fields.meaning: Plant type: Fluyente (508), Con regulación propia (embalse) (301), Desconocido (46), Reversible (20), blank (1)
Installed turbine power in kW (non-zero in only 106/876 records)
Gross hydraulic head in meters (non-zero in 606/876 records)

steps: Request WFS GetFeature on typeNames=agua:aprov_hidro_central (plus agua:aprov_hidro_toma and agua:aprov_hidro_restitucion if intake/outlet locations are needed) with outputFormat=application/json.
Convert potencia_t from kW to MW by dividing by 1,000, treating 0 as missing (770/876 rows).
Filter out records with invalid latitude=0 (y30_ed50=0) before spatial joins.
reading_traps: 34 of 876 features have corrupted y30_ed50=0 giving latitude=0 in the Gulf of Guinea (e.g. [-7.4886, 0] for Domico, Elordi, Ereñozu).
770 of 876 features (87.9%) carry potencia_t=0 rather than null, so zeros cannot be interpreted as 0 MW.
Layer metadata and date are undocumented on MITECO's WMS directory; SIA download page (/sia-/infodescargas.html) returns 404.

evidence.claim: GeoServer AprovHidro service exposes Central, Toma, and Restitución layers under Aprovechamientos Hidroeléctricos.
WFS GetCapabilities lists agua:aprov_hidro_central (Central).

sources.adds: Weekly updated (2026-11-10) dataset of 375 major peninsular reservoirs (>5 hm3) that cleanly separates 94 hydroelectric reservoirs (electrico_flag=1 / Uso='Hidroeléctrico') from 281 consumptive ones — fixing the broken USO tags in UP_Presas_y_embalses — plus weekly storage and theoretical stored energy.

coverage.geographic: Peninsular Spain (excludes Balearic and Canary Islands, and excludes reservoirs <= 5 hm3)

unit.value: hm3 for agua_total and agua_actual; GWh/MWh theoretical stored energy for energia_total and energia_actual.

inclusion_rule.value: Peninsular reservoirs with total capacity > 5 hm3.
inclusion_rule.quote: En este fichero excel se recogen los datos de capacidad y reserva hídrica de cada uno de los embalses peninsulares mayores de 5 hm3 desde el año 1988.

update_frequency.quote: El Boletín Hidrológico es una publicación de periodicidad semanal

exclusions.value: Excludes reservoirs <=5 hm3, islands, power capacity (MW), operator names, and actual observed plant generation (energia_actual is theoretical potential).

steps: Query Embalses_Mapa/FeatureServer/0 with where=electrico_flag=1 for the 94 major hydroelectric reservoirs (or 1=1 for all 375 >5 hm3 reservoirs).
For full weekly history back to 1988 (767,552 rows), query Embalses_Total/FeatureServer/0 or download BD-Embalses.zip using HTTP/1.1 (--http1.1) and extract BD-Embalses.mdb.
reading_traps: energia_total and energia_actual represent theoretical potential hydroelectric energy stored in the reservoir, NOT actual annual generation (MWh) by power plants.

coverage.geographic: Europe (4,264 rows total; 342 rows for Spain, country_code='ES')

unit.value: MW for installed_capacity_MW and pumping_MW; Mm3 (hm3) for volume_Mm3; MWh for storage_capacity_MWh; GWh for avg_annual_generation_GWh; meters (m) for dam_height_m (nominal head).
unit.quote: Useful capacity of the reservoir in million of cubic meters

inclusion_rule.value: Utility-scale hydro plants compiled for power-system modelling (~94% of Spain's ~17.1 GW fleet; omits many small run-of-river plants <1-10 MW).

exclusions.value: No operator/owner field; volume_Mm3 missing for 280/342 Spain rows; avg_annual_generation_GWh missing for 334/342 Spain rows; excludes small <10 MW units.

key_fields.meaning: Installed electrical generation capacity in MW (342/342 populated)
Nominal hydraulic HEAD in meters — NOT structural dam height
Useful reservoir capacity in million m3 / hm3 (62/342 populated)
Expected/average annual generation in GWh (8/342 populated)

steps: Download jrc-hydro-power-plant-database.csv directly and filter country_code == 'ES' (342 records).
Use lat and lon (WGS84, 0/342 out of Spain bbox) and installed_capacity_MW; join with MITECO UP_Presas_y_embalses spatially for full dam metadata.
reading_traps: Field named dam_height_m is actually 'Nominal head of the dam in meters' per datapackage.json (e.g. BARRIOS DE LUNA 1 = 300.3 m head, Tajo encantada = 341 m head), NOT structural dam height.
volume_Mm3 is blank in 81.9% (280/342) and avg_annual_generation_GWh in 97.7% (334/342) of Spanish plants; operator/owner is absent.
Covers 342 plants totaling 16,084.52 MW (omitting hundreds of small run-of-river plants present in MITECO WFS / CH Duero).

evidence.claim: dam_height_m represents nominal head and volume_Mm3 represents useful reservoir capacity under CC-BY-4.0.
evidence.quote: Nominal head of the dam in meters

evidence.claim: Hosted under JRC Data Catalogue WEFE collection.

sources.name: WRI Global Power Plant Database v1.3.0
sources.adds: Provides operator/owner (124/124) and commissioning year (116/124) for 124 major Spanish hydro plants (15,659.14 MW), plus observed generation (2015-2017) for 11-12 plants and modeled estimated_generation_gwh (2013-2017) for all 124.

coverage.geographic: Global (34,936 plants; 829 in Spain, of which 124 have primary_fuel='Hydro')

unit.value: MW for capacity_mw; GWh for generation_gwh_YYYY and estimated_generation_gwh_YYYY.

inclusion_rule.value: Utility-scale plants (124 hydro plants totaling 15,659.14 MW, primarily >= ~10-20 MW from REE 2015 report).

reference_date.value: 2021-06 (v1.3.0 release; Spanish hydro attributes trace to REE 2015 report and ENTSO-E 2015-2017)

exclusions.value: No dams or reservoir volumes; observed generation only in 11-12/124 plants (2015-2017) and 0/124 in 2018-2019; omits small hydro and post-2015 ownership changes (e.g. Acciona->Endesa).

key_fields.meaning: Observed annual generation in GWh (only 11-12/124 populated)

steps: Download global_power_plant_database.csv and filter country == 'ESP' and primary_fuel == 'Hydro' (124 rows).
Distinguish observed generation_gwh_* (sparse: 11-12 rows) from modeled estimated_generation_gwh_*.
reading_traps: estimated_generation_gwh_* (HYDRO-V1) is synthetic modeled output, not observed plant generation.
Owner names reflect pre-2021 corporate structures (e.g. VIESGO GENERACION, ACCIONA) and do not capture recent divestments such as Endesa's acquisition of 34 Acciona plants.

evidence.claim: DATABASE_VERSION confirms v1.3.0; tested CSV shows 124 Spain Hydro rows with owner and capacity_mw.

sources.name: ENTSO-E Transparency Platform (Installed Capacity & Generation per Unit >=100 MW)
sources.adds: Mandatory official EU Regulation (EU) 543/2013 reporting (submitted by Spanish TSO Red Eléctrica and unit owners) giving actual hourly/annual generation and installed capacity per production/generation unit >= 100 MW.

coverage.geographic: Europe / Spain (ES bidding zone; limited to units >= 100 MW)

unit.value: MW for capacity; MWh for generation.

inclusion_rule.quote: In accordance with Regulation 543/2013, the ENTSO-E Transparency Platform was launched on 5 January 2015.

exclusions.value: Excludes all hydro plants/units < 100 MW, coordinates, dam structures, and reservoir volumes; requires free account & security token.

key_fields.meaning: Production/generation unit name and EIC code (>=100 MW)
Installed capacity (MW) or actual generation per unit (MWh)

steps: Register for an ENTSO-E Transparency Platform account and request a REST API security token.
Query Installed Capacity per Production Unit and Actual Generation per Generation Unit for Spain (EIC 10YES-REE------0).
reading_traps: Only units >= 100 MW are reported individually, missing the vast majority of Spain's hydro plants by count.
Web portal is a JS SPA; API access requires authentication token.

problems: Homepage returns JS SPA shell ('This application requires JavaScript to run') and REST API requires user registration/token.

evidence.claim: Regulation (EU) 543/2013 makes submission by EU Member State data providers and owners mandatory on ENTSO-E Transparency Platform.
evidence.quote: Through this Regulation, it has now become mandatory for European Member State data providers and owners to submit fundamental information related to electricity generation, load, transmission and balancing for publication through the ENTSO-E Transparency Platform.

evidence.claim: ENTSO-E Transparency Platform requires JavaScript web UI or registered API access.
evidence.quote: We have detected that JavaScript is disabled. This application requires JavaScript to run.

sources.name: GeoDAR v1.0/v1.1 & GRanD v1.3 (Global Dams and Reservoirs)
sources.license: CC-BY-4.0 (excluding restricted ICOLD WRD proprietary fields)
sources.adds: Harmonized global dam points and reservoir polygons bridging ICOLD World Register of Dams and GRanD v1.3 (1,044 GeoDAR v1.1 points in Iberian/Balearic bbox; 262 Spain-labeled GRanD v1.3 dams with dam height, reservoir capacity, and main use).

coverage.geographic: Global (24,783 dams in GeoDAR v1.1; 1,044 points in Iberian/Balearic bbox; 262 Spain rows in GRanD_v13_issues.csv)

unit.value: Million m3 (mcm = hm3) for rv_mcm_v11 and CAP_MCM; meters (m) for DAM_HGT_M.

inclusion_rule.value: ICOLD WRD large dams + GRanD v1.3 reservoirs.

exclusions.value: GeoDAR v1.1 intentionally omits dam names, country codes, operators, MW capacity, and generation due to ICOLD WRD copyright; only GRanD_v13_issues.csv retains country/use.

key_fields.meaning: Reservoir storage volume in million m3 (354/1,044 Iberian bbox points)
Foreign key to GRanD_v13_issues.csv (262 Spain dams with CAP_MCM, DAM_HGT_M, MAIN_USE)

steps: Download GeoDAR_v10_v11.zip from Zenodo.
Clip GeoDAR_v11_dams.shp / GeoDAR_v11_reservoirs.shp spatially to Spain's polygon (a naive lat/lon bbox mixes Portugal and southern France), or filter GRanD_v13_issues.csv on COUNTRY == 'Spain'.

sources.name: Global Energy Monitor — Global Hydropower Tracker (GHT)
sources.format: XLSX (via form) / Google Sheets summary tables
sources.adds: Up-to-date (March 2026) utility-scale hydro tracker (>=30 MW) including prospective/under-construction projects, capacity (MW), operator/owner, coordinates, and status, gated behind a download request form.

unit.quote: Capacity is measured in megawatts, and refers to the collective nameplate capacity of the hydroelectric power plant.

inclusion_rule.value: >= 30 MW nameplate capacity (lowered from 75 MW -> 45 MW -> 30 MW by March 2026).
inclusion_rule.quote: It includes all facilities with at least 30 megawatts (MW) of nameplate capacity for operating, announced, pre-construction, and under construction units.

reference_date.quote: The most recent release of this data was in March 2026.

exclusions.value: Excludes all plants < 30 MW, dam structural inventories without hydro, reservoir volumes, and annual generation.

key_fields.meaning: Operating, announced, pre-construction, construction, cancelled, mothballed, retired

steps: Request dataset download via the form at https://globalenergymonitor.org/download-data/ (or inspect summary Google Sheets linked on the GHT page).
Filter Country/Area == 'Spain'.
reading_traps: Omits all Spanish hydropower plants under 30 MW (hundreds of small/minihydro plants).

problems: Bulk spreadsheet download requires submitting an interactive web request form (gem-download-form.bundle.js), not tested per rules.

evidence.claim: March 2026 release includes facilities >= 30 MW.
evidence.quote: It includes all facilities with at least 30 megawatts (MW) of nameplate capacity for operating, announced, pre-construction, and under construction units.

sources.name: SEPREM — Inventario de Presas: Presas Españolas
sources.publisher: Sociedad Española de Presas y Embalses (SEPREM)
sources.adds: Association-maintained HTML table of 1,226 large Spanish dams giving dam height (Altura m), reservoir volume (Embalse hm3), basin (Vertiente), and completion year (Finalizada) without anti-bot gates.

unit.value: m for Altura; hm3 for Embalse.

inclusion_rule.value: Large dams in Spain (1,226 records across 48 pages).

exclusions.value: No coordinates, no operator, no MW capacity, no annual generation; no bulk CSV/JSON download.

key_fields.meaning: Reservoir capacity in hm3 ('---' for saddle dikes)

how_to_use.example_result: 1223 ZUFRE | GUADALQUIVIR | 64,000 | 168,000 | 1991 ... 1226 ZUMAJO | C. ATLÁNTICA ANDALUZA | 25,000 | 2,000 | 1908
steps: Iterate HTML pages p=1 through p=48 on presases.php.
Convert Spanish comma decimals (e.g. '168,000' -> 168.0 hm3) and treat '---' on saddle dikes (e.g. ZUJAR DIQUE DEL COLLADO) as null.
reading_traps: Comma decimals carry three trailing zeros (e.g. '64,000' = 64 m, NOT 64,000 m).
Includes auxiliary dikes like ZUJAR (DIQUE DEL COLLADO) with '---' for Embalse (hm3).

evidence.claim: Table lists 1,226 Spanish dams with height, reservoir volume (hm3), basin, and completion year.

coverage.geographic: Global / Spain (ISO3166-1=ES; ohsome bbox -9.4,35.9,4.4,43.8 covers Iberia & Balearics up to 2026-07-27)

Dam structure tag (5,511 in Iberian/Balearic bbox via ohsome)
Nameplate capacity when tagged (954/1,022 in Iberian/Balearic bbox)
Operator name when tagged (574/1,022 in Iberian/Balearic bbox)

regulator.name: MITECO (Ministerio para la Transición Ecológica y el Reto Demográfico — Secretaría de Estado de Energía & Dirección General del Agua) and CNMC (Comisión Nacional de los Mercados y la Competencia)

operators.note: Electricity transmission is operated by a single TSO (Red Eléctrica de España / Redeia), while hydropower plants and dams have many operators: major utilities (Iberdrola, Endesa — which acquired 34 Acciona hydro plants totaling 626 MW —, Naturgy, EDP), hundreds of small-hydro owners, and 9 state Confederaciones Hidrográficas plus intracomunitary regional water agencies managing state/public dams.

publication_obligation.norm: Ley 24/2013 del Sector Eléctrico (Art. 21.2) and Real Decreto 413/2014 (Art. 37) for RAIPRE power plants; Real Decreto 849/1986 (RDPH Art. 363), Real Decreto 264/2021, and Orden TED/572/2025 (Art. 4) for dam safety registration; Texto Refundido de la Ley de Aguas (Art. 80) for Registro de Aguas.
publication_obligation.what_must_be_published: All authorized electricity production plants must register in RAIPRE (Sección 1ª >50 MW; Sección 2ª <=50 MW) with capacity and key attributes; dams >5 m high or >100,000 m3 must register in the Registro de Seguridad de Presas y Embalses (deadline 2026-07-01 in state basins).
publication_obligation.frequency: Continuous registration upon authorization, modification, or decommissioning (Electra open-data export documented as daily; Boletín Hidrológico weekly; Inventario de Presas listed as annual on datos.gob.es).

consolidated_republication.note: Dams and reservoirs are consolidated nationally via MITECO DGA ArcGIS REST services, while hydropower plants remain split/incomplete across MITECO WFS (missing most MW and all operators), CAPTCHA-gated PRETOR/REPROv2, Electra (stripped columns), and basin/regional portals; plant-level annual generation is not consolidated nationally.

checked_pages.saw: Links to Sección 2ª (PRETOR) and Sección 1ª (REPROv2), whose public query pages use image CAPTCHAs; Electra bulk dump omits technology, operator, coords, and >50 MW Fases.

checked_pages.organization: MITECO — Dirección General del Agua (Inventario de Presas y Embalses & WFS)
checked_pages.saw: Static Shapefiles gated by Altcha; however, open ArcGIS REST FeatureServers (UP_Presas_y_embalses, Embalses_Mapa) and GeoServer WFS (agua:aprov_hidro_central) consolidate national dams and hydro concessions.
Publishes only monthly/annual aggregated statistics (capacity, plant count, primed energy) for installations under the specific remuneration regime; no plant-level list.

checked_pages.organization: Red Eléctrica de España (REE — REData & e·sios)
checked_pages.saw: REData API exposes aggregated national/regional hydro generation and capacity; e·sios maps are JS SPAs and api.esios.ree.es returns HTTP 403 (Incapsula) without token.

national_registry.note: Statutory registries exist for both domains: RAIPRE (PRETOR <=50 MW + REPROv2 >50 MW) for power plants, and Inventario de Presas y Embalses / Registro de Seguridad de Presas (Orden TED/572/2025) + Registro de Aguas (ALBERCA) for dams and water concessions. However, public RAIPRE queries require CAPTCHAs, Electra's open export drops key fields, and MITECO's static dam downloads require Altcha, leaving UP_Presas_y_embalses ArcGIS REST and agua:aprov_hidro_central WFS as the open national interfaces.

checked_pages.saw: Public RAIPRE search in PRETOR (InformesInstalaciones.aspx) and REPROv2 (RegistroPublico.aspx) gated by image CAPTCHA; Electra CSV/XLSX stops at 2026-01-27 without technology or owner.
Orden TED/572/2025 Registro de Seguridad has 2026-07-01 initial filing deadline and no open bulk dump yet; UP_Presas_y_embalses ArcGIS REST serves 3,208 dams and 3,170 reservoirs openly.
Only aggregated statistics from specific-remuneration liquidations; no national plant or dam registry.
Interactive JS viewer with Incapsula script; REData API provides only aggregated hydro generation/capacity.
WFS INSPIRE Hydrography serves 28,774 generic dams/weirs (hy-p:DamOrWeir) without capacity, volume, operator, or hydro classification.
National catalog indexes Electra, Inventario de Presas (referencing broken/SSL-failing mapama WMS), IGN Hydrography, and CH Duero hydro plants.

recipe: Start with MITECO UP_Presas_y_embalses FeatureServer (Layer 1 for reservoir volumes in hm3 and TITULAR; Layer 0 for dam points, avoiding USO filters and multi-dike volume double-counting) and Embalses_Mapa (where electrico_flag=1 flags 94 major hydro reservoirs).

Download MITECO WFS agua:aprov_hidro_central (filtering out 34 rows with lat=0) and JRC Hydro-power database (342 ES plants with MW) + WRI (124 ES plants with owner) + available basin/regional open sources (CH Duero, CH Júcar, CH Cantábrico, INEGA Galicia, Andalucía DERA).

For missing plant-level capacities, operators, or new/repowered plants (>50 MW), search BOE (/buscar/boe.php) and SABIA for 'central hidroeléctrica' / 'central hidráulica reversible' resolutions (extracting MW, promoter, municipality, and reservoir volume from Sec. III / Sec. V PDFs or HTML).

For individual <=50 MW or >50 MW official RAIPRE records (when human CAPTCHA entry is feasible), look up plants interactively in PRETOR (<=50 MW) or REPROv2 (>50 MW) or check the basin Registro de Aguas (ALBERCA).
if_unstructured.location_method: Use exact coordinates from MITECO UP_Presas_y_embalses FeatureServer (dams/reservoirs), MITECO agua:aprov_hidro_central WFS (842 valid plants), JRC/WRI, and basin GIS layers (CH Júcar, CH Cantábrico, Andalucía DERA). For plants listed only by municipality/river in BOE, Electra, CH Duero, or INEGA Galicia, cross-match against MITECO WFS/UP_Presas_y_embalses or locate the powerhouse/dam via IGN PNOA-MA orthophoto WMTS.
cross_with: MITECO UP_Presas_y_embalses (Layer 1 Embalses) with Embalses_Mapa (electrico_flag=1) to isolate major hydroelectric reservoirs with weekly storage and capacity.

MITECO agua:aprov_hidro_central WFS with JRC Hydro-power database (spatial proximity) and CH Duero / CH Júcar / INEGA / DERA basin lists to combine coordinates, MW, operator, and partial annual generation.

where_published.name: Boletín Oficial del Estado (BOE) — Administrative Authorizations (Sec. III)
where_published.what: Final ministerial resolutions granting prior and construction authorization for >50 MW or inter-community hydropower plants and pumped-storage facilities.
where_published.how_to_search_inside: Full-text search at boe.es/buscar/boe.php filtering by department (Ministerio para la Transición Ecológica y el Reto Demográfico) and keywords ('central hidroeléctrica' or 'central hidráulica reversible').

example_document.what_it_gives: From BOE-A-2026-22600 (p. 144083): operator 'Hidroeléctrica Los Guájares, SLU', plant 'central hidráulica reversible «Los Guájares»', capacity 'potencia de turbinación de 356,93 MW y una potencia de bombeo de 363,99 MW', municipalities 'Vélez de Benaudalla, El Pinar y Los Guájares (Granada)'.

where_published.name: Boletín Oficial del Estado (BOE) — Public Consultations & EIA Announcements (Sec. V)
where_published.what: Public information notices for new/modified hydro concessions, authorizations, and Environmental Impact Declarations (DIA), linked to MITECO SABIA dossiers.
where_published.how_to_search_inside: Search boe.es/buscar/boe.php for 'información pública' plus 'central hidroeléctrica' / 'aprovechamiento hidroeléctrico' / 'hm3' or browse MITECO SABIA (sede.miteco.gob.es/portal/site/seMITECO/navSabiaDestacados).

example_document.what_it_gives: Public EIA/authorization notice for CHR Los Guájares giving reservoir details absent from Sec. III: 'aprovechamiento hidroeléctrico de las aguas procedentes del embalse de Rules', 'Depósito superior: Depósito de 1,4 Hm3, con un volumen útil de 1 Hm3', 'Salto (bruto/neto) máximo: 613/602,8 m'.

open_questions: Whether MITECO's new Registro de Seguridad de Presas y Embalses (Orden TED/572/2025, initial filing deadline 2026-07-01) will expose a unified public downloadable inventory with updated dam/owner records.
Whether MITECO will restore daily updates and add technology/operator/location fields to the Electra open-data export (frozen since 2026-01-27).
